stories.title: Gillespie County Sheriff: Tenant kills well-loved astronomy buff Gabe Segura in Stonewall standoff

stories.title: One last love letter: San Antonio Zoo mourns Fiona, Timothy the hippo’s longtime sweetheart

stories.title: ‘Mud is not a getaway strategy’: Bexar County deputies arrest stolen vehicle suspect
stories.summary: A suspect’s attempted escape ended off-road in the mud before deputies took him into custody, according to the sheriff’s office.

stories.title: 'Give him the honor that he's due': Navy sailor Kenneth Lynch finally to be buried in Texas, 85 years after Pearl Harbor attack
stories.summary: The sailor, who left Denton in 1940, will be buried with full military honors next month in his hometown.

stories.title: A new ride for more second chances: San Antonio Feral Cat Coalition gets transport van

stories.title: Why fall foliage looks different across South Central Texas
stories.summary: Fall colors vary across South Central Texas, and the combination of cooler temperatures and geography helps determine where vibrant foliage develops.

stories.summary: Firefighters cut into a roof and sprayed water between two closely spaced buildings to keep flames from spreading inside, according to a battalion chief.
